bullets.title: Drunken monkey hypothesis
bullets.note: From Wikipedia: “\[The Drunken monkey hypothesis\] proposes that human attraction to ethanol may derive from dependence of the primate ancestors of _Homo sapiens_ on ripe and fermenting fruit as a dominant food source.” Thanks to [Dr. Mark Plotkin](https://tim.blog/2020/09/30/mark-plotkin/) ([@DocMarkPlotkin](https://twitter.com/docmarkplotkin)) for introducing me to this hypothesis. Learn more about Mark [here](https://tim.blog/2020/09/30/mark-plotkin/).
